`final class PixelGrid.Span`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.matrix` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [PixelGrid.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/matrix/PixelGrid.java)

The snapped edges of a shape along one axis, with the coverage that fades a span thinner than a pixel.

## Description

`spanX` and `spanY` of [`PixelGrid`](/reference/pipeline/pixelgrid/) return it.
Draw between `getStart()` and `getEnd()`, and multiply the alpha of the color by `getCoverage()`.

## Learn more

- [Pixel alignment](/use/in-depth/pixel-alignment/#thin-lines-keep-their-weight)

<a id="PixelGrid-Span-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `double` | [getStart](#PixelGrid-Span-method-getStart)() | Returns the design coordinate of the near edge, on a pixel boundary when the grid is aligned. |
| `double` | [getEnd](#PixelGrid-Span-method-getEnd)() | Returns the design coordinate of the far edge, on a pixel boundary when the grid is aligned. |
| `float` | [getCoverage](#PixelGrid-Span-method-getCoverage)() | Returns the share of the drawn pixels that the shape covers, from `0F` to `1F`: below `1F` only for a span thinner than one screen pixel. |
